name: Ayano
source: The only daughter of [url=/c92902]Nao-san[/url], the owner of a coffee shop in town. Ayano is a third year student at Sakurazaki High School. She is crazy about cricket, so she feels bad about having to retire from the club (at the end of the school year when she graduates). She enjoys spending her days devoting herself to sports.
